name: Smoked Turkey sandwich
description: Premium smoked turkey slices paired with fresh greens, melted cheddar, and our signature sauce on a toasted multi-seed baguette.

name: Steak Sandwich
description: Tender strips of grilled steak topped with caramelized onions, melted provolone, and a touch of horseradish mayo.

name: Tuna Sandwich
description: Flaky tuna chunks mixed with sweet corn, colorful peppers, and a light herb dressing for a refreshing bite.

name: Tiramisu
description: A classic Italian masterpiece featuring layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and rich, velvety mascarpone cream.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake
description: Smooth and creamy New York-style cheesecake topped with a vibrant homemade strawberry glaze and fresh fruit.

name: Chocolate Creap
description: Delicate handmade crepe filled with warm Nutella and garnished with a medley of fresh seasonal berries.

name: Greek Salad
description: A crisp mix of cucumbers, tomatoes, and Kalamata olives, topped with authentic feta cheese and extra virgin olive oil.

name: Potato Salad
description: Herb-infused potato cubes tossed in a light vinaigrette, finished with fresh parsley and vibrant pomegranate seeds.

name: Tabbouleh Salad
description: Traditional Lebanese parsley salad with fine bulgur, ripe tomatoes, and a zesty lemon-mint dressing.

name: Butter Croissant
description: Golden, buttery, and flaky French croissants baked fresh daily for that perfect morning crunch.

name: Raspberry Danish
description: A buttery, multi-layered Danish pastry filled with smooth custard and topped with a vibrant raspberry glaze and fresh berries.

name: Danish Roll
description: Classic heart-shaped French pastry featuring crispy, caramelized layers of puff pastry with a delicate hint of sweetness.
